subject.title: [Bug]: Control UI header logo/icon not displaying after 2026.3.24 update

question: Should Control UI hard refreshes and bookmarks on legacy or arbitrary non-tab route prefixes be supported for public assets, or should support stay limited to root, known app routes, configured basePath, and /__openclaw__?
rationale: Current code has partial fixes, but the remaining behavior changes the supported URL contract and Gateway static-file boundary, so automation should not choose that policy alone.

options.title: Support safe public assets on deep routes
options.body: Land a narrow allowlist for known Control UI public assets under supported SPA route prefixes while preserving 404 behavior for unknown static filenames.

options.title: Limit to documented entrypoints
options.body: Document root, known app routes, configured basePath, and /__openclaw__ as the supported URL shapes and close the linked fork work with that rationale.

options.title: Adopt or replace the fork PR
options.body: Use the open fork PR only if its approach matches the chosen URL contract; otherwise close it and request or create a narrower replacement.

recommendation.title: Support safe public assets on deep routes
recommendation.body: Land a narrow allowlist for known Control UI public assets under supported SPA route prefixes while preserving 404 behavior for unknown static filenames.

likelyOwner.reason: They are tied to the current public-asset routing code and recent Gateway asset fixes.
